name: Can AKN Design Group install custom-sized interior doors for older homes in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex?

mainEntity.name: Can AKN Design Group install custom-sized interior doors for older homes in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AKN Design Group has extensive experience working with older homes in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, which often have non-standard door openings. Our expertise in customized renovations allows us to address unique architectural features. During our design-build process, we will assess existing openings and either source custom-sized doors or expertly modify framing to accommodate standard sizes, ensuring a perfect fit and seamless integration that respects the home's character while enhancing its modern functionality and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AKN Design Group can install custom-sized interior doors for older Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex homes, either sourcing custom sizes or modifying framing for seamless integration.
